### Visual, Sensory & Accessibility Requirements
- [ ] WCAG 2.1 AA contrast verified ($\ge 4.5:1$ text, $\ge 3.0:1$ large elements)
- [ ] Touch target $\ge 48 \times 48\text{ px}$ ($\ge 64 \times 64\text{ px}$ for tablet AAC grids)
- [ ] Low-cognitive-load and autism-friendly sensory design (no jarring animations, clear visual hierarchy)
- [ ] Directional layout mirrored for native Arabic (RTL) and French/English (LTR)
- [ ] Typography conforms to IBM Plex Sans Arabic / Manrope / Inter
- [ ] **Color Palette Status Note:** Brand color palette is currently **unapproved** (pending Product Owner selection). Do not hardcode unapproved tokens as final.
